relations: Chocolate coating on the upright bar melts where the clip grips, dripping into the pale puddle below.
As the clip holds the bar, the softened base may slump, widening the melt pool on the tray.
The standing bar persists vertically until melting weakens its grip, then it can tilt or drop.
Melted liquid accumulates at the tray surface, spreading outward from the clip's contact point.
